visual.general_description: Two-panel grayscale pituitary MRI figure: (A) coronal and (B) sagittal T1-weighted post-contrast slices, each with on-image caliper measurements across a sellar mass.
visual.detailed_description: A 750 x 407 pixel composite of two grayscale MRI slices separated by a thin white gap and labeled A (left, coronal) and B (right, sagittal) at their lower-left corners. Panel A shows a rounded sellar mass with a vertical caliper reading 13.8 mm and a horizontal caliper reading 17.1 mm above a black air-filled sinus region. Panel B shows a head sagittal slice with a rounded sellar mass crossed by a horizontal caliper reading 15.2 mm. The only text in the image is the panel letters and the three measurement labels; no patient identifiers, dates, scanner annotations, arrows or faces are visible.

panels.general_description: Coronal T1-weighted post-contrast MRI of the sellar region with caliper measurements 17.1 mm and 13.8 mm across a sellar mass.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale coronal MRI slice at the level of the sella. In the upper half, dark frontal-horn-like ventricular spaces with a thin septum lie above and between rounded brain tissue; small bright round vessel-like dots appear near the base on both sides. At the center is a rounded intermediate-to-bright, slightly heterogeneous soft-tissue region sitting in the sellar area, with a bright flanking round structure on each side. Two on-image calipers are drawn across it: a vertical yellow-green line whose label above the top reads 13.8 mm, and a horizontal white line labeled 17.1 mm at its right end. Beneath the mass is a large black signal-void region (consistent with air) with a bright septated/mucosal structure on its left and thin bright curved walls around it. The letter A is printed at the lower-left corner of the panel. No arrows, orientation letters, patient identifiers or other text are visible.

panels.general_description: Sagittal T1-weighted post-contrast MRI of the sellar region with a 15.2 mm caliper across a rounded sellar mass.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale sagittal MRI slice of the head, anterior toward the left of the panel: skull outline and gyral cerebral surface at the top, an arched corpus callosum and brainstem/cerebellar region toward the right, and nasal/sphenoid sinus structures with bright mucosa and a black air region at the lower left. In the sellar region at the center is a rounded intermediate-signal mass with a thin bright rim; a single horizontal yellow-green caliper line spans it and is labeled 15.2 mm at its right. The pituitary stalk-like thin bright band runs down and to the right from the mass region. The letter B is printed at the lower-left corner of the panel. No arrows, other labels, patient identifiers or text are visible; black margins fill the upper-left corner.
